intro: The Binding is the final trial in an aspiring Horde warlock's quest to enslave a succubus in Orgrimmar. By channeling the lingering demonic pull within Dogran's Pendant at Neeru Fireblade's summoning circle, the warlock wrenches a demon from the Twisting Nether and breaks its will through force of arms and spellcraft.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, friend. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising warlock.
When you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.

clips.title: Progress
paras: When I look upon a succubus, my heart begins to soar... But at the same time, I can almost sense my soul's ebb, drifting away like the tides.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

You have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.
Leave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.
